events.title: Hotfix: a crash, recruited deserters, starting distance and more
events.summary: Hi everyone, This is a quick hotfix for problems you reported over the last day that got in the way of playing. Thanks for the reports, they helped us find the causes fast. Fixes Fixed a crash to desktop when coming back to the map after a fight while another band was fighting nearby. Recruited deserters no longer fight on both sides. events.title: Demo update: fixes for jobs and combat, and rain on the battlefield
events.summary: Hi everyone, This update is mostly fixes. Many of them come straight from your reports during Next Fest, like jobs that couldn't be finished or fights that started with the enemy almost on top of you. Thank you to everyone who took the time to write. Fixes: jobs and contracts Every job can now be finished. events.title: Demo update: retreats, smarter enemies and a livelier world
events.summary: Hi everyone, Thank you for all the feedback during Next Fest. We read every comment, and a lot of what you've told us is in this update. CombatEnemies act according to who they are. A seasoned fighter reads the battlefield better than a green one, and a band's leader commands only as well as they're able. Hover an enemy to see what drove their last move. events.title: Demo update: smarter enemies, hit chances info and recruits more personalities
events.summary: Hi everyone, Here's another round of changes for the demo, a lot of them shaped by what you've been telling us. Combat Your hit chance now shows why it is what it is. Small icons under the number show what adds to it and what takes away, and holding ALT spells it out in words. Enemies fight smarter. They weigh cover, flanks and the cost of each move like you do, back up a comrade under pressure, look after themselves when hurt, and pull back in order when a fight turns. events.title: Demo update: a longer demo, clearer combat and settings that stick
events.summary: Hi everyone, Thank you to everyone who played the demo and shared feedback. This update follows a lot of what you told us: the demo is longer, combat is easier to read, and your settings now stay the way you leave them. The demoThe demo now lasts 30 game days instead of 15. CombatFixed a freeze that could happen when an enemy learned a new technique in the middle of a fight. Hovering a move or an action shows which action point diamonds it would use, before you confirm.
